card.name: Lists of lesbian and feminist figures
card.fires_on: Linking words and commas in lists of named people or works in lesbian, feminist or LGBT cultural writing, such as "such as" or commas between author names.

modes.label: List openers
modes.description: The words "such as" or "included" that introduce a list of authors, films or activists in LGBT or feminist topics.
modes.example: prominent and controversial academic writers such<< as>> Camille Paglia and Germaine

modes.label: Commas and "and" between names
modes.description: Commas or "and" separating names of authors, activists or entertainers in such a list.
modes.example: Other key thinkers and activists have included Rita Mae Brown, Audre Lorde<<,>> Marilyn Frye,

card.writes: Little clear link to the output; the suppressed tokens are gender, race and LGBT words, so it may hold back more topic words in favor of the next name.
card.plain: It fires on the small words and commas that introduce or separate names in lists of lesbian and feminist authors, films and activists.
